rics.description: Commercial banks. outstanding credits to individuals, in rupiah
rics.meaning: Outstanding credits of commercial banks to individuals (in rupiah) — total household debt at banks. Includes mortgages, vehicle loans, multipurpose loans, credit cards.
rics.how_to_use: Indonesia's household debt is low by international standards (~17% of GDP vs 50-100% for DM). Mortgages dominate (~40% of household credit), followed by multipurpose loans, vehicle loans, credit cards. Household-credit-to-GDP rising signals deepening financial inclusion — generally positive but watch for excess.

rics.description: Outstanding credits of commercial banks, housing
rics.meaning: Outstanding Housing Credits at commercial banks — KPR (Kredit Pemilikan Rumah) mortgages. The largest single household credit category.
rics.how_to_use: Indonesia mortgage market is small but growing — mortgage-to-GDP ~3% (vs 30-60% for DM). Highly rate-sensitive: surge in BI cuts drives KPR demand. OJK macroprudential tools include mortgage LTV caps (currently 80-90% for first home, lower for second/third).
